metadata.title: Klotilda — Original Ceramics, Textiles & Embroidery
metadata.description: Handmade ceramics, textiles, and embroidery by a Czech artist. Each piece is one of a kind.

about.title: About
about.bio1: My name is Klotilda and I create in Prague. My work grows from a love of traditional crafts — ceramics, weaving, and embroidery — which I connect with a contemporary sensibility.
about.bio2: Each piece is made by hand in my studio, without rush. I believe the objects around us can be not only beautiful but deeply personal.

cta.title: Originals for Sale
cta.subtitle: Each piece is unique and waiting for its new owner.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: I'm happy to talk about collaborations, commissions, or just say hello.
